Learned counsel for appellant has filed a memo which reads as under:
"The appellant in the above case is prays this Hon'ble Court to permit to withdraw the appeal has not pressed in the interest of justice and equity".
2. In view of the same the above appeal is dismissed as not pressed.
The amount deposited by the appellant be transmitted to the Tribunal for disbursement in terms of the award of the Tribunal.
3. Records of the Tribunal be returned forthwith.
